# Composer

Composer offers a clean, readable layout tuned for long-form notes. Color schemes, typography, table and callout styles, and task checkbox visuals are adjustable through the Style Settings plugin.

![Composer screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vran-dev/obsidian-composer/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Composer"
    author: "vran-dev"
    repo:   "vran-dev/obsidian-composer"
    slug:   "composer"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/composer"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/vran-dev/obsidian-composer"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vran-dev/obsidian-composer/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Read and write comfortably with a clean, readable layout tuned for long-form notes. Switch color schemes and tweak typography, table and callout styles, and task checkbox visuals with the Style Settings plugin."
}
```
